title: IOU (借据)
description:
[h1]IOU[/h1]
Adds a new shop relic, the [b]IOU[/b]. Every merchant gives it to you for free until you take it.

[b]Buy now, pay later[/b]
[list]
[*]Buy anything from the merchant on credit, borrowing up to [b]250[/b] Gold (interest not counted, so you can owe up to [b]325[/b]). Your Gold goes negative and turns red.
[*]Borrowed Gold must be repaid with [b]30%[/b] extra (rounded up).
[*]Gold you earn pays off the debt automatically.
[*]Once your debt is paid off, the IOU is used up and you cannot borrow again that run.
[/list]

[b]Requires [url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=3737335127]BaseLib[/url].[/b]

[h1]借据[/h1]
新增商店遗物[b]借据[/b]：每个商店都会免费赠送，直到你拿走为止。
[list]
[*]在商店购物时可以赊账，最多借 [b]250[/b] 金币（利息另算，最多欠 [b]325[/b]），金币会变成红色的负数。
[*]赊账借的金币需要额外偿还 [b]30%[/b]（向上取整）。
[*]之后获得的金币会自动用来还债。
[*]还清欠款后，借据失效，本局不能再赊账。
[/list]

[b]需要先订阅 [url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=3737335127]BaseLib[/url]。[/b]
changeNote: Rebalance: the IOU is now free, you can borrow up to 250 Gold, and borrowed Gold costs 30% interest instead of reducing combat Gold.
